member.name: M:Milvonion.Api.AppStartup.StartupExtensions.EnsureTokenSigningKey(Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder.WebApplicationBuilder)
member.summary: Makes sure the access token signing key () is configured before the identity services read it. The key is a secret, so the appsettings files leave it empty: a shared environment sets it through the environment (Milvasoft__Identity__Token__SymmetricPublicKey), a developer through user secrets. Outside Development a missing or too short key stops the startup with a message that names the setting, instead of a key length error from the token library or, worse, a key everybody knows. In Development a random key is generated for this run and a warning is written, so a fresh clone (and dotnet ef) starts without setup; the tokens issued with it stop working on the next start.

member.name: M:Milvonion.Api.AppStartup.MissingResxKeyFinder.LocalizerLiteralKeyRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
[Ll]ocalizer\\??\\[\\s*"(?<key>[^"]+)"
Explanation:
○ Match a character in the set [Ll].
○ Match the string "ocalizer".
○ Match '?' atomically, optionally.
○ Match '['.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match '"'.
○ "key" capture group.
○ Match a character other than '"' atomically at least once.
○ Match '"'.

member.name: M:Milvonion.Api.AppStartup.MissingResxKeyFinder.LocalizerNameofKeyRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
[Ll]ocalizer\\??\\[\\s*nameof\\((?<expression>[\\w\\.]+)\\)
Explanation:
○ Match a character in the set [Ll].
○ Match the string "ocalizer".
○ Match '?' atomically, optionally.
○ Match '['.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match the string "nameof(".
○ "expression" capture group.
○ Match a character in the set [.\w] atomically at least once.
○ Match ')'.

member.name: M:Milvonion.Api.AppStartup.MissingResxKeyFinder.LocalizerKeysReferenceRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
\\bLocalizerKeys\\.(?<name>\\w+)
Explanation:
○ Match if at a word boundary.
○ Match the string "LocalizerKeys.".
○ "name" capture group.
○ Match a word character atomically at least once.

member.name: M:Milvonion.Api.AppStartup.MissingResxKeyFinder.CommentLineRegex
member.remarks:
Pattern:
^\\s*//.*$
Options:
RegexOptions.Multiline
Explanation:
○ Match if at the beginning of a line.
○ Match a whitespace character atomically any number of times.
○ Match the string "//".
○ Match a character other than '\n' greedily any number of times.
○ Match if at the end of a line.

member.name: T:Milvonion.Api.Middlewares.SecurityStampValidationMiddleware
member.summary: Enforces token revocation. Runs after authentication: for an authenticated request it compares the token's session-stamp claim against the user's current stamp (Redis, with a database fallback). A mismatch means the token was revoked (password change, role change, lock, deletion) and the request is rejected with 401. A token without a stamp claim is rejected as well: every token this API mints (login, refresh, long-lived, documentation) carries one, so a missing claim means a foreign token that could never be revoked. Endpoints marked with are not checked.

member.name: T:Milvonion.Api.Utils.IdempotentAttribute
member.summary: Makes a create endpoint safe to retry. The client sends the same Idempotency-Key header for every attempt at one user action (a double tap, a request the network lost, the single retry the HTTP layer does after a token refresh); the first attempt claims the key and does the work, later attempts get that attempt's response back instead of creating a second record.

remarks.para: Only endpoints that create a row with no natural uniqueness need this (e.g. a role: two roles may share a name). Upserts, conditional writes and creates guarded by a unique index are idempotent on their own.
Requests without the header run untouched, so an older client keeps working.

This is a resource filter, not an action filter, so the raw body is still readable: the key is pinned to a hash of the route and the body it was first used with, and the same key with a different body is rejected instead of replaying the wrong response.
Cost: one extra INSERT on the first attempt; a retry pays one read and answers without doing the work. Keys are stored per caller, so one user's key can never replay another's response.

member.name: T:Milvonion.Api.Utils.RateLimitAttribute
member.summary: Per-caller rate limit for a single endpoint: a light defense-in-depth layer behind the proxy's own throttling. Counts requests in a fixed time window in Redis (atomic INCR + expiry, key ), keyed by the authenticated user (falling back to the client IP for anonymous callers; always the client IP on [AllowAnonymous] endpoints), and returns HTTP 429 once the limit is exceeded. Limits are meant to sit well above normal human usage so they only bite abuse and scripts. Fails OPEN: if Redis is unreachable or errors, the request is allowed through (availability over strictness).
member.param: Max requests allowed within the window.
Length of the fixed window, in seconds.
Stable bucket name (defaults to the action). Endpoints sharing a name share one counter.

member.name: T:Milvonion.Api.Utils.ResponseStatusCodeFilter
member.summary: Global result filter that sends failed envelopes with a real HTTP status code instead of 200. Handlers keep returning with IsSuccess=false; this filter reads the message key (see ) and sets both the wire status and the envelope's so the two never disagree. Results that already carry an explicit non-200 status are left untouched.

member.name: T:Milvonion.Api.Utils.ResponseStatusCodes
member.summary: Maps the message keys handlers put on a failed to the HTTP status code the response should be sent with. Handlers keep returning the envelope (IsSuccess=false + messages); this is the single place that decides whether that failure is a 400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 429, 500 or 503 on the wire. Unknown keys fall back to 400 so a new message key can never accidentally produce a 200. When a new message key is added and it is not a 400, it is added to this table too.

member.name: M:Milvonion.Api.Utils.ResponseStatusCodes.FromKey(System.String)
member.summary: Resolves the HTTP status code for a single message key. Unknown or empty keys map to 400.

member.name: M:Milvonion.Api.Utils.ResponseStatusCodes.FromResponse(Milvasoft.Components.Rest.MilvaResponse.IResponse)
member.summary: Resolves the HTTP status code for a failed response from its messages. The first message that maps to a non-400 code wins (a response never carries more than one "reason" in practice); anything else is 400. Successful responses always resolve to 200 regardless of their messages.

member.name: T:Milvonion.Api.Utils.SkipSessionStampValidationAttribute
member.summary: Exempts an endpoint from the token revocation check (SecurityStampValidationMiddleware); authentication and authorization still apply. Only for the bootstrap endpoints that must work before the token's user exists: on a fresh database the documentation (Scalar) token names a root user that is not seeded yet, so its stamp cannot be validated. Such an endpoint must be disabled in production and harmless once the database is initialized.
